description: Upload a local image, audio or video file to use as a generation input (image_url, first_frame_url, reference_*_urls, audio_url). Free. The returned url is PUBLIC, so only upload a file the user explicitly asked you to use. Works only inside the folders the user listed in AIVEED_MCP_UPLOAD_DIRS; hidden and system folders are never read, and only files with a valid media structure are accepted.

path.description: Absolute path of the local file

name: upload_media
title: Upload media
